title: Gripper assembly, apparatus for recovering a layout from a sheet material and method for separating a layout from waste of a sheet material

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The conveyor unit 14 is equipped with a vacuum system 15 for holding the sheet material 12 on an associated surface of the conveyor unit 14 .
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum system for holding the sheet material, which implies an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
features.refuted: The quote describes a vacuum system but does not specify it is electrically operated or that it is a vacuum generating device in the housing.

A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
